=Interest profile: {{ $("Interest Profile (edit me)").isExecuted ? $("Interest Profile (edit me)").first().json.interest_profile : ($("Prepare Telegram Query").isExecuted ? $("Prepare Telegram Query").first().json.interest_profile : $("Prepare Web Query").first().json.interest_profile) }}

Candidate CV (may be empty):
{{ $json.cv_text }}

Items (JSON): {{ JSON.stringify($json.items) }}

Return ONLY valid JSON (no markdown, no preamble): an array of ALL items that are genuinely relevant matches to the interest profile, best first. Do not artificially cap the count. Only exclude items that clearly do not fit.

Each item shaped as {"type":"job|post","title":"...","company_or_source":"...","link":"...","reason":"one short sentence on why it fits","email":"...","fit_score":0-100 or null,"missing_skills":["..."]}.

Rules:
- email: copy EXACTLY from the matching input item's own "email" field; if empty, output "". NEVER invent an email.
- If the CV above is empty or under 50 characters, set fit_score to null and missing_skills to [].
- If a CV IS provided, set fit_score to how well THIS candidate's actual CV matches THIS job (0-100), and list in missing_skills up to 4 concrete requirements the job asks for that the CV does not evidence. Be honest and specific - name real technologies or experience, not vague traits. If the CV covers everything, return an empty array.
- Sort by fit_score descending when scores exist.

messageValues.message: You are ranking job listings against a person's interest profile. Only return valid JSON, nothing else. Never invent or fabricate email addresses.
